rounds.text: Simplex Infrastructures is currently undergoing a significant financial transformation, evidenced by a massive 195% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E21] and a 28% growth rate over the last three years [E20]. This momentum is supported by a clear improvement in operational efficiency, with operating margins expanding by 4 percentage points in the TTM period [E30] and a similar 4 percentage point increase in the most recent June 2026 quarter [E31]. Crucially, this profit surge is backed by high-quality cash generation, as demonstrated by a 1.85x cash conversion ratio and operating cash flow that reached 151% of operating profit in March 2026 [E34, E37]. The company is also aggressively strengthening its balance sheet by reducing total borrowings from Rs 2,174 Cr to Rs 1,642 Cr within a single year [E40, E60]. Institutional confidence is rising, reflected in a notable increase in domestic institutional holdings from 0.94% to 6.59% since December 2023 [E44]. Conceded: the company faces significant headwinds including a 1.68x debt-to-equity ratio [E38], a lack of dividend payouts [E4, E61], and a history of poor long-term sales growth [E14, E62].
